comment: Our LAN cluster (verified 2026-11-22). Copy to cluster.json (gitignored) to adjust. The first host of every config runs rank 0 and must be the machine that executes run_all.ps1. Hosts are given by IP: name resolution does not work on our LAN. netmask is passed as -genv MPICH_NETMASK so MS-MPI ignores virtual/Wi-Fi adapters. pop values are the smoke-test sizes; tune them per card (one generation well under the Windows TDR limit, about 2 s).
